info: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command[20101]

      INSERT INTO "Orders" ("Amount", "Customer", "OrderNumber")
      VALUES (@p0, @p1, @p2)
      RETURNING "Id";
info: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command[20101]
      Executed DbCommand (0ms) [Parameters=[@__p_0='?' (DbType = Int64)], CommandType='Text', CommandTimeout='30']
      SELECT o."Id", o."Amount", o."Customer", o."OrderNumber"
      FROM "Orders" AS o
      WHERE o."Id" = @__p_0
      LIMIT 1
（值得注意两条: 建表、插、查的 SQL 原文都在日志里, 类到表、方法调用到 SQL 的翻译当场可查证; 正文里 404 带 JSON 双引号是框架序列化字符串的真实行为, 非记档加工）
